en.text: Now while Ezra prayed and made confession, weeping and casting himself down before God’s house, there was gathered together to him out of Israel a very great assembly of men and women and children; for the people wept very bitterly.

zhSimplified.text: 以斯拉祷告，认罪，哭泣，俯伏在 神殿前的时候，有以色列中的男女孩童聚集到以斯拉那里，成了大会，众民无不痛哭。

zhTraditional.text: 以斯拉禱告，認罪，哭泣，俯伏在上帝殿前的時候，有以色列中的男女孩童聚集到以斯拉那裏，成了大會，眾民無不痛哭。

en.text: Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered Ezra, “We have trespassed against our God, and have married foreign women of the peoples of the land. Yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing.

zhSimplified.text: 属以拦的子孙、耶歇的儿子示迦尼对以斯拉说：「我们在此地娶了外邦女子为妻，干犯了我们的 神，然而以色列人还有指望。

zhTraditional.text: 屬以攔的子孫、耶歇的兒子示迦尼對以斯拉說：「我們在此地娶了外邦女子為妻，干犯了我們的上帝，然而以色列人還有指望。

en.text: Now therefore let’s make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives and those who are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God. Let it be done according to the law.

zhSimplified.text: 现在当与我们的 神立约，休这一切的妻，离绝她们所生的，照着我主和那因 神命令战兢之人所议定的，按律法而行。

zhTraditional.text: 現在當與我們的上帝立約，休這一切的妻，離絕她們所生的，照着我主和那因上帝命令戰兢之人所議定的，按律法而行。

en.text: Arise, for the matter belongs to you and we are with you. Be courageous, and do it.”

zhSimplified.text: 你起来，这是你当办的事，我们必帮助你，你当奋勉而行。」

zhTraditional.text: 你起來，這是你當辦的事，我們必幫助你，你當奮勉而行。」

en.text: Then Ezra arose, and made the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel to swear that they would do according to this word. So they swore.

zhSimplified.text: 以斯拉便起来，使祭司长和利未人，并以色列众人起誓说，必照这话去行；他们就起了誓。

zhTraditional.text: 以斯拉便起來，使祭司長和利未人，並以色列眾人起誓說，必照這話去行；他們就起了誓。

en.text: Then Ezra rose up from before God’s house, and went into the room of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib. When he came there, he didn’t eat bread or drink water, for he mourned because of the trespass of the exiles.

zhSimplified.text: 以斯拉从 神殿前起来，进入以利亚实的儿子约哈难的屋里，到了那里不吃饭，也不喝水；因为被掳归回之人所犯的罪，心里悲伤。

zhTraditional.text: 以斯拉從上帝殿前起來，進入以利亞實的兒子約哈難的屋裏，到了那裏不吃飯，也不喝水；因為被擄歸回之人所犯的罪，心裏悲傷。

en.text: They made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together to Jerusalem;

zhSimplified.text: 他们通告犹大和耶路撒冷被掳归回的人，叫他们在耶路撒冷聚集。

zhTraditional.text: 他們通告猶大和耶路撒冷被擄歸回的人，叫他們在耶路撒冷聚集。

en.text: and that whoever didn’t come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his possessions should be forfeited, and he himself separated from the assembly of the captivity.

zhSimplified.text: 凡不遵首领和长老所议定、三日之内不来的，就必抄他的家，使他离开被掳归回之人的会。

zhTraditional.text: 凡不遵首領和長老所議定、三日之內不來的，就必抄他的家，使他離開被擄歸回之人的會。

en.text: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together to Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the wide place in front of God’s house, trembling because of this matter, and because of the great rain.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，犹大和便雅悯众人，三日之内都聚集在耶路撒冷。那日正是九月二十日，众人都坐在 神殿前的宽阔处；因这事，又因下大雨，就都战兢。

zhTraditional.text: 於是，猶大和便雅憫眾人，三日之內都聚集在耶路撒冷。那日正是九月二十日，眾人都坐在上帝殿前的寬闊處；因這事，又因下大雨，就都戰兢。

en.text: Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have trespassed, and have married foreign women, increasing the guilt of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司以斯拉站起来，对他们说：「你们有罪了；因你们娶了外邦的女子为妻，增添以色列人的罪恶。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司以斯拉站起來，對他們說：「你們有罪了；因你們娶了外邦的女子為妻，增添以色列人的罪惡。

en.text: Now therefore make confession to the LORD, the God of your fathers and do his pleasure. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign women.”

zhSimplified.text: 现在当向耶和华—你们列祖的 神认罪，遵行他的旨意，离绝这些国的民和外邦的女子。」

zhTraditional.text: 現在當向耶和華－你們列祖的上帝認罪，遵行他的旨意，離絕這些國的民和外邦的女子。」

en.text: Then all the assembly answered with a loud voice, “We must do as you have said concerning us.

zhSimplified.text: 会众都大声回答说：「我们必照着你的话行，

zhTraditional.text: 會眾都大聲回答說：「我們必照着你的話行，

en.text: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand outside. This is not a work of one day or two, for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.

zhSimplified.text: 只是百姓众多，又逢大雨的时令，我们不能站在外头，这也不是一两天办完的事，因我们在这事上犯了大罪；

zhTraditional.text: 只是百姓眾多，又逢大雨的時令，我們不能站在外頭，這也不是一兩天辦完的事，因我們在這事上犯了大罪；

en.text: Now let our princes be appointed for all the assembly, and let all those who are in our cities who have married foreign women come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city and its judges, until the fierce wrath of our God is turned from us, until this matter is resolved.”

zhSimplified.text: 不如为全会众派首领办理。凡我们城邑中娶外邦女子为妻的，当按所定的日期，同着本城的长老和士师而来，直到办完这事， 神的烈怒就转离我们了。」

zhTraditional.text: 不如為全會眾派首領辦理。凡我們城邑中娶外邦女子為妻的，當按所定的日期，同着本城的長老和士師而來，直到辦完這事，上帝的烈怒就轉離我們了。」

en.text: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against this; and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

zhSimplified.text: 惟有亚撒黑的儿子约拿单，特瓦的儿子雅哈谢阻挡这事，并有米书兰和利未人沙比太帮助他们。

zhTraditional.text: 惟有亞撒黑的兒子約拿單，特瓦的兒子雅哈謝阻擋這事，並有米書蘭和利未人沙比太幫助他們。

en.text: The children of the captivity did so. Ezra the priest, with certain heads of fathers’ households, after their fathers’ houses, and all of them by their names, were set apart; and they sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

zhSimplified.text: 被掳归回的人如此而行。祭司以斯拉和些族长按着宗族都指名见派；在十月初一日，一同在座查办这事，

zhTraditional.text: 被擄歸回的人如此而行。祭司以斯拉和些族長按着宗族都指名見派；在十月初一日，一同在座查辦這事，

en.text: They finished with all the men who had married foreign women by the first day of the first month.

zhSimplified.text: 到正月初一日，才查清娶外邦女子的人数。

zhTraditional.text: 到正月初一日，才查清娶外邦女子的人數。

en.text: Among the sons of the priests there were found who had married foreign women: of the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

zhSimplified.text: 在祭司中查出娶外邦女子为妻的，就是耶书亚的子孙约萨达的儿子，和他弟兄玛西雅、以利以谢、雅立、基大利；

zhTraditional.text: 在祭司中查出娶外邦女子為妻的，就是耶書亞的子孫約薩達的兒子，和他弟兄瑪西雅、以利以謝、雅立、基大利；

en.text: They gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.

zhSimplified.text: 他们便应许必休他们的妻。他们因有罪，就献群中的一只公绵羊赎罪。

zhTraditional.text: 他們便應許必休他們的妻。他們因有罪，就獻群中的一隻公綿羊贖罪。

en.text: Of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

zhSimplified.text: 音麦的子孙中，有哈拿尼、西巴第雅。

zhTraditional.text: 音麥的子孫中，有哈拿尼、西巴第雅。

en.text: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

zhSimplified.text: 哈琳的子孙中，有玛西雅、以利雅、示玛雅、耶歇、乌西雅。

zhTraditional.text: 哈琳的子孫中，有瑪西雅、以利雅、示瑪雅、耶歇、烏西雅。

en.text: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

zhSimplified.text: 巴施户珥的子孙中，有以利约乃、玛西雅、以实玛利、拿坦业、约撒拔、以利亚撒。

zhTraditional.text: 巴施戶珥的子孫中，有以利約乃、瑪西雅、以實瑪利、拿坦業、約撒拔、以利亞撒。

en.text: Of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (also called Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

zhSimplified.text: 利未人中，有约撒拔、示每、基拉雅（基拉雅就是基利他），还有毗他希雅、犹大、以利以谢。

zhTraditional.text: 利未人中，有約撒拔、示每、基拉雅（基拉雅就是基利他），還有毗他希雅、猶大、以利以謝。

en.text: Of the singers: Eliashib. Of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

zhSimplified.text: 歌唱的人中有以利亚实。守门的人中，有沙龙、提联、乌利。

zhTraditional.text: 歌唱的人中有以利亞實。守門的人中，有沙龍、提聯、烏利。

en.text: Of Israel: Of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人巴录的子孙中，有拉米、耶西雅、玛基雅、米雅民、以利亚撒、玛基雅、比拿雅。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人巴錄的子孫中，有拉米、耶西雅、瑪基雅、米雅民、以利亞撒、瑪基雅、比拿雅。

en.text: Of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.

zhSimplified.text: 以拦的子孙中，有玛他尼、撒迦利亚、耶歇、押底、耶利末、以利雅。

zhTraditional.text: 以攔的子孫中，有瑪他尼、撒迦利亞、耶歇、押底、耶利末、以利雅。

en.text: Of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.

zhSimplified.text: 萨土的子孙中，有以利约乃、以利亚实、玛他尼、耶利末、撒拔、亚西撒。

zhTraditional.text: 薩土的子孫中，有以利約乃、以利亞實、瑪他尼、耶利末、撒拔、亞西撒。

en.text: Of the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

zhSimplified.text: 比拜的子孙中，有约哈难、哈拿尼雅、萨拜、亚勒。

zhTraditional.text: 比拜的子孫中，有約哈難、哈拿尼雅、薩拜、亞勒。

en.text: Of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.

zhSimplified.text: 巴尼的子孙中，有米书兰、玛鹿、亚大雅、雅述、示押、耶利末。

zhTraditional.text: 巴尼的子孫中，有米書蘭、瑪鹿、亞大雅、雅述、示押、耶利末。

en.text: Of the sons of Pahathmoab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.

zhSimplified.text: 巴哈·摩押的子孙中，有阿底拿、基拉、比拿雅、玛西雅、玛他尼、比撒列、宾内、玛拿西。

zhTraditional.text: 巴哈‧摩押的子孫中，有阿底拿、基拉、比拿雅、瑪西雅、瑪他尼、比撒列、賓內、瑪拿西。

en.text: Of the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

zhSimplified.text: 哈琳的子孙中，有以利以谢、伊示雅、玛基雅、示玛雅、西缅、

zhTraditional.text: 哈琳的子孫中，有以利以謝、伊示雅、瑪基雅、示瑪雅、西緬、

en.text: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

zhSimplified.text: 便雅悯、玛鹿、示玛利雅。

zhTraditional.text: 便雅憫、瑪鹿、示瑪利雅。

en.text: Of the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

zhSimplified.text: 哈顺的子孙中，有玛特乃、玛达他、撒拔、以利法列、耶利买、玛拿西、示每。

zhTraditional.text: 哈順的子孫中，有瑪特乃、瑪達他、撒拔、以利法列、耶利買、瑪拿西、示每。

en.text: Of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,

zhSimplified.text: 巴尼的子孙中，有玛玳、暗兰、乌益、

zhTraditional.text: 巴尼的子孫中，有瑪玳、暗蘭、烏益、

en.text: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,

zhSimplified.text: 比拿雅、比底雅、基禄、

zhTraditional.text: 比拿雅、比底雅、基祿、

en.text: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

zhSimplified.text: 瓦尼雅、米利末、以利亚实、

zhTraditional.text: 瓦尼雅、米利末、以利亞實、

en.text: Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasu,

zhSimplified.text: 玛他尼、玛特乃、雅扫、

zhTraditional.text: 瑪他尼、瑪特乃、雅掃、

en.text: Bani, Binnui, Shimei,

zhSimplified.text: 巴尼、宾内、示每、

zhTraditional.text: 巴尼、賓內、示每、

en.text: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,

zhSimplified.text: 示利米雅、拿单、亚大雅、

zhTraditional.text: 示利米雅、拿單、亞大雅、

en.text: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

zhSimplified.text: 玛拿底拜、沙赛、沙赖、

zhTraditional.text: 瑪拿底拜、沙賽、沙賴、

en.text: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,

zhSimplified.text: 亚萨利、示利米雅、示玛利雅、

zhTraditional.text: 亞薩利、示利米雅、示瑪利雅、

en.text: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

zhSimplified.text: 沙龙、亚玛利雅、约瑟。

zhTraditional.text: 沙龍、亞瑪利雅、約瑟。

en.text: Of the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, Joel, and Benaiah.

zhSimplified.text: 尼波的子孙中，有耶利、玛他提雅、撒拔、西比拿、雅玳、约珥、比拿雅。

zhTraditional.text: 尼波的子孫中，有耶利、瑪他提雅、撒拔、西比拿、雅玳、約珥、比拿雅。

en.text: All these had taken foreign wives. Some of them had wives by whom they had children.

zhSimplified.text: 这些人都娶了外邦女子为妻，其中也有生了儿女的。

zhTraditional.text: 這些人都娶了外邦女子為妻，其中也有生了兒女的。
